name: Tavern Hound
ability: Liquid Courage / Friend Guard / Tangled Feet (hidden)
look: a big burly Saint Bernard with heavy jowls, sleepy eyes, rosy cheeks and a full oak keg under its chin
entry: It strides the snowy passes with a full keg of warm tonic under its chin, and lost hikers who hear it baying know help is coming, slowly but surely.
how: Evolve Stumblepup at level 30. It learns Super Fang when it evolves.
Wild: rare in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
